rumors.title: Musk: Grok 4.7 in ~10 days (~Sep 12)

rumors.title: Scoop: OpenAI finished 'Bel' >10T pretrain
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: @synthwavedd Aug 25 scoop that OpenAI finished next pretrain codename Bel (successor to Doug), rumored >10T total params as base for Astra/GPT-6 with further RL. OpenAI has not confirmed Bel, param count, or roadmap role — rumor/not verified reporting.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: @amir (The Information) update that Nvidia is in talks to put ~$2.5–3B into Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab, citing a16z; round-size figures elsewhere still conflict ($1B vs $5–6B). No closed round announced — rumor/not verified financing.
